calls.error: kind must be wall, slab, roof, covering, column, beam, footing, railing, door or window
name is required
layers must be a list of 1 to 20 {material, thickness, category, role}, the thickness in metres
layer 1 needs a material
layer 1: thickness must be a number greater than zero (metres)
layer 1: category must be concrete, steel, aluminium, block, brick, stone, wood, glass, gypsum, plastic, earth or null
layer 1: role must be load_bearing, insulation, inner_finish, outer_finish or null
the layers add up to more than 5 m
USERDEFINED needs the name of a kind of its own, which define_type does not take; choose a value from the class's list, or NOTDEFINED
predefined_type must be a PredefinedType such as SOLIDWALL, PARTITIONING, FLOOR or BASESLAB, or null
a roof type is an IfcSlabType ROOF; leave predefined_type null
new-1 is a wall type named YV1 already; give its ref as type, or choose another name
new-2 is a slab type named BJ1 already; give its ref as type, or choose another name
a column type has no layers; give its material as material, or null

operation must be SINGLE_SWING_LEFT, SINGLE_SWING_RIGHT, DOUBLE_SWING_LEFT, DOUBLE_SWING_RIGHT, DOUBLE_DOOR_SINGLE_SWING, DOUBLE_DOOR_DOUBLE_SWING, SLIDING_TO_LEFT, SLIDING_TO_RIGHT or DOUBLE_DOOR_SLIDING
width and height must be 0.3 to 20 m
lining_depth must be 0.05 to 2 m
material_category must be concrete, steel, aluminium, block, brick, stone, wood, glass, gypsum, plastic, earth or null
type new-2 is a slab type; create_wall takes a wall type
thickness 0.3 m differs from the 0.2 m of the layers of type new-1; leave thickness null

calls.error: partition true makes a non-load-bearing wall; leave partition null for a load-bearing wall
load_bearing must be true, false or null (not given)
status must be NEW, EXISTING, DEMOLISH, TEMPORARY or null
type new-1 is a wall type; create_slab takes a slab type
type new-1 is a wall type; create_opening takes a door or window type
type new-3 is a door type, so fill must be door or null
with a type of the model, give fill door or window
width 1.2 m differs from the 0.9 m of type new-3; leave width and height null
side must be left or right, seen from the wall's start toward its end, or null for left

ifc_class must be IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcMember, IfcFooting, IfcPile, IfcCovering, IfcRailing, IfcChimney, IfcShadingDevice, IfcSanitaryTerminal, IfcFurniture, IfcFurnishingElement or IfcStair; walls, slabs, roofs, openings with their doors and windows, and spaces have tools of their own, and IfcBuildingElementProxy is never used
predefined_type must be a value of the class's list, such as COLUMN or STRIP_FOOTING (search_ifc_class gives them), or null
USERDEFINED needs object_type, the name of its kind; or choose a value of the class's list (search_ifc_class)
define_type makes no type for IfcMember; give a type of the model by its GlobalId or id, or null
type new-1 is a wall type; IfcColumn takes a column type
type new-4 is not a type; give the ref of a define_type step, or a type's id or GlobalId
shape must be {profile, x, y, radius, outline, depth, along}
shape.profile must be rectangle, circle or polygon
shape.y is required (metres)
shape.depth is required (metres)
shape.depth must be at most 200 m
shape.along must be z (standing, extruded up from z) or x (lying, extruded in the direction of rotation)
shape.outline must be 3 to 500 different [x, y] corners
a polygon is an outline in the plan, so shape.along must be z
at must be [x, y] in metres
stair is for IfcStair; IfcColumn takes shape
host is for IfcCovering: the element or space it covers; a part of a whole is part_of
part_of new-4 is the create_wall step; part_of takes create_element or create_roof
an IfcStair takes stair, not shape
an IfcStair needs stair: {risers, riser_height, tread_length, width, thickness, landing}
stair.risers must be a whole number from 2 to 60
stair.riser_height is required (metres)
stair.thickness 0.1 m (the waist at right angles to the slope) must be at least the riser height, 0.175 m
create_element makes straight stairs of one flight: predefined_type STRAIGHT_RUN_STAIR or null
a stair is not part_of another element and covers nothing, so part_of and host must be null
room number 101 is listed twice; a room number is unique in the building
Pset_WallCommon.AcousticRating: give the number only, without its unit (40, not "40 dB"): IFC gives the property its unit
Pset_WallCommon.ThermalTransmittance: give the number only, without its unit (0.18, not " 0,18 W/m²K "): IFC gives the property its unit

calls.error: qto_  is no set's name: give IFC's set, such as Pset_WallCommon, or a set of your own, such as SE-ACME-42_Acoustics
category goes with a material
category must be concrete, steel, aluminium, block, brick, stone, wood, glass, gypsum, plastic, earth or null

nothing to change: a wall takes start, end, thickness, height and type; a slab outline, thickness and type; an opening, door or window offset, width, height and sill; a roof pitch, overhang and base; any element name; give at least one, and null for the rest
name must not be empty; null keeps it
start and end are the same point

start, pitch do not go together: a wall takes start, end, thickness, height and type; a slab outline, thickness and type; an opening, door or window offset, width, height and sill; a roof pitch, overhang and base; any element name
outline must be at least three [x, y] points, or null to keep it
pitch must be more than 0 and at most 75 degrees
overhang must be zero or more (metres)
new-1 is made by define_type, so it takes only name
type new-2 is a slab type; edit_element gives a wall a type of its own kind
thickness 0.3 m differs from the 0.2 m of the layers of type new-1; leave thickness null
type new-3 is a door type; edit_element gives a wall a type of its own kind
id is required: the element's id, GlobalId or ref (new-1, …)
vertical_datum goes with a crs, such as EPSG:3006 with RH 2000
EPSG:5850 gives its heights in RH 2000 already; leave vertical_datum null, or give the plan code EPSG:3011 with vertical_datum NN 1900
